description: Turn a 24-hour fine particle (PM2.5) concentration in micrograms per cubic meter into the Air Quality Index and its category, using EPA's 2024 breakpoints, with the breakpoint row it fell in and the EPA document it comes from. A conversion for a number you already have: it reads no live air quality and uses no key. For today's air in a place, open Air Today.

pm25.description: A 24-hour average PM2.5 concentration in micrograms per cubic meter, from 0 to 1000. EPA truncates it to a tenth.

name: aqi_from_particles
title: AQI for a PM2.5 concentration
